(Search snippet content — aggregated from WebSearch result summaries; Jordanian government denial)

The Jordanian government denied reports that authorities ordered the evacuation of Aqaba's airport and seaport, after the US embassy said they had been evacuated over a "credible threat."

Jordanian government spokesperson Dr Mohammad Al-Momani: "no potential threats have been recorded by the relevant Jordanian authorities in the past few hours" and "the authorities have not issued any evacuation orders at Aqaba Airport or the port", adding both facilities were operating normally.
